blocks.text: Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) fiza mein dhoop mein NOx aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs) se banti hai; yeh oxidising nau'iyat ki hai. Photochemical oxidants jaise NO2, ozone aur peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) fiza mein khaas compounds se react kar ke unhen oxidise kar sakte hain. Barhte NOx ikhraj ki wajah se photochemical smog classical smog (London smog) se zyada aam hoti ja rahi hai. Us ke banne mein yeh reactions shamil hain: N2 + O2 se 2NO; 2NO + O2 se 2NO2; NO2 dhoop (hv) se NO + O; O + O2 se O3; aur alkene + O3 se aldehyde aur radicals jo aage RC(O)OONO2, peroxyacyl nitrate, tak le jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Photochemical smog banne ke reactions likhein aur batayein ke dhoop kyun zaroori hai (exercise Q.2e).
blocks.explanation: N2 + O2 se 2NO; 2NO + O2 se 2NO2; NO2 + hv se NO + O; O + O2 se O3; O3 hydrocarbons ke saath aldehydes aur radicals deti hai jo PAN par khatam hote hain. Dhoop NO2 ki photolysis ke liye chahiye, jo oxygen atoms deti hai jo ozone banate hain, smog ka bunyadi oxidant; is ke baghair zanjeer shuru nahi hoti.

items: Photochemical (Los Angeles) smog: dhoop mein NOx + VOCs, oxidising (NO2, O3, PANs); ab London smog se aam. NO2 + hv O deta hai, O + O2 O3 deta hai, O3 hydrocarbons ko PAN ki taraf oxidise karti hai.
